accelCalibrationState.note_one: Accelerometer {{which}} has no stored 3D calibration. Run the Quick calibration (one position, vehicle level) or the 6-point one: the Level calibration only sets trims and will not clear "3D Accel calibration needed".
accelCalibrationState.note_other: Accelerometers {{which}} have no stored 3D calibration. Run the Quick calibration (one position, vehicle level) or the 6-point one: the Level calibration only sets trims and will not clear "3D Accel calibration needed".

calibratingStep.hintCompass: Keep rotating your vehicle in all directions...
calibratingStep.hintCompassPx4: Hold the vehicle on a side, rotate it when prompted, then move to the next side...
calibratingStep.hintFinalizing: Please wait - do not disconnect the flight controller
calibratingStep.hintLevel: Keep your vehicle still on the level surface...
calibratingStep.hintOpflow: Hold steady over the textured surface...
calibratingStep.hintSixPoint: Hold the position steady, then click "Position Ready"
calibratingStep.hintSixPointPx4: Hold each position still, the vehicle detects and captures sides automatically
calibratingStep.holdAnySide: Hold the vehicle still on any side, detection is automatic
calibratingStep.noProgressData: Still no progress data. Keep rotating; if this persists past a minute, the link may be dropping calibration messages or the compass is not producing usable data.
calibratingStep.rotateWaiting: Rotate the vehicle, waiting for progress from the flight controller

calibrationCompleteStep.couldNotVerifyBody: {{error}} The flight controller still reported success, but ArduDeck could not confirm the new values were written.
calibrationCompleteStep.failedBody: An error occurred during calibration. Please try again.
calibrationCompleteStep.noteAllSaved: All saved. Returning to calibration menu...
calibrationCompleteStep.noteMavlinkFlash: The flight controller already applied the calibration. Use "Save Calibration to Flash" so it persists across reboots.
calibrationCompleteStep.noteMavlinkSaved: The flight controller has applied and saved the calibration.
calibrationCompleteStep.noteMsp: Calibration data has been applied. Click "Save to FC" to persist changes to flash memory.
calibrationCompleteStep.noteSavedFlash: Calibration saved to flash memory. You can also save to persistent storage above to survive firmware updates.
calibrationCompleteStep.rebootFailed: Reboot command failed, reboot from the connection panel instead.
calibrationCompleteStep.rebootRequiredBody: The new compass offsets only take effect after the flight controller reboots. Until then the EKF will report yaw inconsistent and arming will be blocked.
calibrationCompleteStep.saveToFlashBody: Calibration is already applied. Write parameters to the FC’s parameter storage so they persist across reboots.
calibrationCompleteStep.saveToPersistentBody: Save calibration data to the bootloader partition. This data will survive firmware updates.
calibrationCompleteStep.savedToFcStorage: Calibration saved to flight controller storage.
calibrationCompleteStep.savedToPersistent: Calibration saved to persistent storage. Data will survive firmware updates.
calibrationCompleteStep.unchangedBody: The flight controller reported success but the tracked parameters did not change. This usually means the calibration silently failed - try again, and if the values still do not move, check the FC logs.
calibrationCompleteStep.unconfirmedBody: The flight controller never confirmed this calibration and the parameter check could not settle it. Verify the calibration parameters changed before flying, or run it again.
calibrationCompleteStep.verifiedBody: ArduDeck re-read the relevant parameters from the flight controller and confirmed they changed.
calibrationCompleteStep.verifyingBody: Reading parameters back from the flight controller to confirm the calibration was applied.
calibrationCompleteStep.verifyingParams: Verifying calibration parameters on flight controller…

calibrationHealthBanner.notConfirmedDetail: Reboot the flight controller and reconnect. ArduDeck will read the values back and confirm they stuck.
calibrationHealthBanner.notSurvived: {{name}} calibration did not survive the reboot
calibrationHealthBanner.notSurvivedDetail: {{summary}} Do not fly on this calibration. Run it again.
calibrationHealthBanner.weak: {{name}} calibration is on the vehicle, but weak

calibrationResultCard.gyroBias: Bias offsets have been updated internally.

compassCoverageView.hint: Dark patches are directions with no samples yet. Drag a sphere to look around.

compassFitPanel.higherPriority: Higher priority: the EKF prefers this one
compassFitPanel.hint: Keep the compass in the best position rather than the best score: an onboard one sits in the battery's field, which moves with current draw and no calibration corrects that.
compassFitPanel.notCalibrated: Not calibrated in this run, keeping its previous values
compassFitPanel.title: Compass fit

compassMotDialog.acknowledge: The vehicle is secured and the area is clear.
compassMotDialog.batteryPowered: Battery-powered (USB alone cannot drive the motors), fully charged.
compassMotDialog.description: Measures compass interference from the motors under load and writes the COMPASS_MOT compensation. Copter firmware only.
compassMotDialog.highWarning: Interference is high. Consider relocating the compass (or use an external GPS/compass mast) further from the power wiring and ESCs.
compassMotDialog.motorsWillSpin: The motors will spin. Secure the vehicle first.
compassMotDialog.propsOn: Props on and everyone clear of the disc.
compassMotDialog.raiseNow: Raise the throttle now. The plot plots interference against throttle as the motors load up. Peak so far: {{peak}}%.
compassMotDialog.raiseThrottle: You will raise the throttle on your transmitter to ~50-75%.
compassMotDialog.saved: Calibration saved. COMPASS_MOT compensation has been written. A reboot is recommended before flying.
compassMotDialog.stepFinish: Press Finish to save. Lower interference is better.
compassMotDialog.stepHold: Hold briefly at high throttle, then smoothly lower back to zero.
compassMotDialog.stepStart: Press Start, then slowly raise throttle to 50-75% over ~5-10 seconds.
compassMotDialog.tieDown: Firmly tie down or hold the frame so it cannot move or flip.
compassMotDialog.title: Compass/Motor Calibration
compassMotDialog.waitingSampling: Waiting for the flight controller to begin sampling...

largeVehicleMagCalDialog.description: Single-shot compass calibration for aircraft that cannot be rotated. Point the vehicle in a known true direction and enter the heading below.
largeVehicleMagCalDialog.headingHint: Heading is true (not magnetic). Use a known landmark, runway alignment, or a separate compass. Accuracy directly affects calibration quality.
largeVehicleMagCalDialog.noGpsLock: No GPS 3D lock. A 3D fix is required so the FC can derive the local earth-field vector. Calibration will fail without it.
largeVehicleMagCalDialog.success: Calibration complete. Compass offsets have been written. A reboot is recommended for the new offsets to take effect.
largeVehicleMagCalDialog.title: Large Vehicle MagCal

liveOrientationGuide.noAttitude: No attitude telemetry: position cannot be checked

loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.appliedCount_one: {{count}} calibration param written and saved to flash
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.appliedCount_other: {{count}} calibration params written and saved to flash
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.blockedMismatch: Sensor IDs do not match this flight controller
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.blockedMissing: File contains no sensor IDs, cannot verify the source board
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.blockedNoData: No calibration data: all offsets in the file are zero
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.description: Restore ACC / MAG calibration from a .param file. The file is verified against this flight controller's sensor IDs before any values are written, and the verified IDs are saved with the offsets so ArduPilot accepts the calibration after reboot.
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.failedCount_one: {{count}} param failed (no PARAM_VALUE confirmation from FC)
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.failedCount_other: {{count}} params failed (no PARAM_VALUE confirmation from FC)
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.noCalParams: No accel or mag calibration parameters found in the selected file.
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.nothingToApply: Nothing to apply: the selected calibration params already match the vehicle.
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.rebootFailed: Reboot command failed. Check the connection and try again, or reboot from the connection panel.
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.rebootRecommended: Reboot the flight controller to make sure all calibration values are loaded from EEPROM cleanly. Some IMU/compass parameters only take effect on boot.
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.title: Load calibration from file
loadCalibrationFromFileDialog.verified: Verified. Sensor IDs match this flight controller and the file contains non-zero calibration data.

prepareCalibrationStep.compassHoldSidePx4: Hold on a side, rotate when prompted
prepareCalibrationStep.compassMounted: External compass must be firmly mounted.
prepareCalibrationStep.gyroInfo: Gyro calibration runs automatically on boot. Manual calibration only needed for drift issues.
prepareCalibrationStep.holdSteady: Hold each position steady, then confirm with the button.
prepareCalibrationStep.holdSteadyPx4: Hold each position steady until the vehicle captures it.
prepareCalibrationStep.sixPositions: Place vehicle in 6 positions - you'll be guided step by step.
prepareCalibrationStep.sixPositionsPx4: Place vehicle in 6 positions - each side is detected and captured automatically.

selectCalibrationStep.compassMotDesc: Measures compass interference from the motors under load and writes COMPASS_MOT compensation. Copter only. Motors spin, secure the vehicle first.
selectCalibrationStep.help: Ensure your vehicle is disarmed and in a safe location before calibrating.
selectCalibrationStep.helpMsp: Ensure your vehicle is disarmed and in a safe location before calibrating. For best results, disconnect motors.
selectCalibrationStep.intro: Choose the sensor you want to calibrate. Some calibrations require specific sensors to be present on your flight controller.
selectCalibrationStep.largeVehicleDesc: Single-shot compass cal for aircraft too large to rotate. Requires GPS lock and a known true heading.
selectCalibrationStep.loadFromFileDesc: Restore ACC / MAG calibration from a .param file. The source board's sensor IDs are verified against this FC before writing.
selectCalibrationStep.noAccelCal: This board has no 3D accelerometer calibration
selectCalibrationStep.noMagnetometer: No magnetometer detected on this flight controller. Add an external compass on I2C to enable it. Not required for Stabilize.
selectCalibrationStep.title: Select Calibration Type

vehicleCalibrationPanel.localOnly: Must be started at the vehicle
vehicleCalibrationPanel.reqLevelSurface: Use a surface you know to be level.
vehicleCalibrationPanel.reqMotorsLive: Motors will spin. Remove the propellers and secure the airframe.
vehicleCalibrationPanel.reqStationary: Put the vehicle down and keep it still.
vehicleCalibrationPanel.waiting: Waiting for the vehicle to report…
